answer: To deter Sybil attacks in an agent fleet mapping an astronomical nebula, radiometric triangulation authenticates physical presence. Each sparrow probe synchronizes directional microwave pings with a reference beacon to verify its spatial coordinates. An attacker incurs inescapable hardware and propellant costs per identity, requiring dedicated transceivers and maneuvering fuel for each node. However, plasma turbulence induces phase jitter that can falsely reject legitimate agents.
